contract: PATCH /api/me/password verifies the current password for a non-guest caller, rejects a mismatch and invalid payload types with 400, changes the stored hash, invalidates the user's other sessions (rotating the current session and returning new tokens only when the x-refresh-token header names it), and lets root set an empty password.
exceptions: force is not applicable: this route has no force, hard or override mode

invariants.contract: PATCH /api/me/password verifies the current password: a wrong password, a missing or non-string password/newPassword answer 400 for a non-guest user, an empty new password answers 400 unless the caller is root, a guest answers 403 and an unauthenticated caller 401; every rejected request leaves the stored hash and the session rows unchanged.

A successful change invalidates sessions: with an x-refresh-token that names one of the user's sessions it rotates that session, destroys the others and returns {success:true,user:{accessToken,refreshToken}} that authenticate; without a matching session it answers 200 without tokens and destroys every session of the user.
Only root may set an empty new password: the route answers 200 and stores an empty hash, while an empty newPassword for a non-root user is 400 and keeps the hash.
A successful change stores a new non-empty password hash that verifies the new password, and no password-change response body contains the stored hash.
